changes.value: Seven names (ADR 0085): Stage::new(theme, size, Pace), present(Presentation), arrive(Painting, Arrival), depart(Departure), draw(Surface, now) -> Motion and pick. The pace, a move's phases and the longest step of the clock, comes at birth. A presentation states only what changed: each value it states replaces the last, and a value it leaves out stays. A cut, a carry, a stay, a clear and a sweep with no lines name no moment and read nothing. Each draw says whether to keep a strip canvas's parts: Surface::Strips wraps the canvas in the stage's part store and culls to the stage's size, and Surface::Direct draws whole, as the GPU canvas, a recording canvas and a counting canvas need. Archboard adds the server's own URL, with auto-start off, and the server's bin directory first on PATH: a thread's archboard is the server's own source in whichever checkout the thread works in, and it never starts another server. On shutdown, stdin closes first. The owner waits within a short EOF grace, then reaps every remaining group within the composed deadline.
